name: usage-report
description: Shows context fill, 5-hour and weekly quota, and session cost on the status line under the prompt, with warnings near your limits.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Show how full the conversation's context window is.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Show this session's cost in US dollars.

style.title: Style
style.description: full shows token counts and reset times; compact is short for narrow terminals.

warnings.title: Limit warnings
warnings.description: Toast when the 5h or weekly window passes 80% and 95%.
